verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents paying vendors/bills/contractors in bulk across 150+ countries and 40+ currencies with no transfer/wire fees, plus scheduled/same-day payments, invoice automation, and MFA-secured payments — clearly covering vendor payment workflows. However, evidence emphasizes cross-border/global payments and stablecoin rails rather than explicitly naming domestic US ACH or wire payment rails/mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit mention of 'ACH' or 'wire transfer' as a domestic US payment method, and any domestic-specific transaction limits or processing details.
